changes.title: Sleeping legends
items: Sleeping legends now look asleep: sunk in their area's earth, mossed over, eyes shut and breathing slowly, instead of the awake legend half-buried (no more strange flat domes poking out of the ground near home)
The elk's and the bear's legends carry a little forest of spruces on their backs, not round lollipop trees

changes.title: Legend rig
items: Sleeping legends lie down with their eyes shut and breathe slowly; in a nightmare their legs paddle and their heads jerk
Woken, a legend gets up drowsily: its head comes up, sags, then it heaves itself out of the ground; lulled, it settles back to sleep

changes.title: Heronry
items: A new kind of area, the heronry: a still mere ringed with reeds under tall elms, an old jetty, and the heron, a new creature with its own sigil, voice and legend's gift (Heron's Stride: a little quicker on foot, and a longer blink)
